test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 7 males A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only four males are to the left of A. B is the immediate neighbour of A and C. D is third to the left of E. F is not the immediate neighbour of E. Who is sitting between D and G?
solution:
**Given:**

7 males A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north 

Only four males are to the left of A

B is the immediate neighbour of A and C.

D is third to the left of E.

F is not the immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03d231716564b7115ee1354c5652e6f5cf45334ecab8d822922a047d4c4ff3fd.png] 

 

According to the table, D is at position 1 and G is at position 3.

The person sitting between D and G is F (at position 2).

Therefore, the male sitting between D and G is **F**.
